population-policies-timeline.alt: Timeline from 1970 to 2026. China: the one-child policy, antinatalist, from 1980 to 2015, then the limit eased to two children from 2016, and a three-child policy from 2021 aimed at raising births. Singapore: Stop at Two, antinatalist, from 1972, then from 1987 a pronatalist call for three or more children if families can afford them. Iran: a family planning program, antinatalist, from 1989, and a 2021 law to raise births.
